facebookresearch_meshtalk/training/forwa.train_autoregressive_model: train the autoregressive context model using CategoricalAutoregressiveForwarder with cross-entropy loss on quantized codes
facebookresearch_meshtalk/training/forwa.reconstruct_geometry: reconstruct 3D facial geometry from expression and audio codes using the geom_unet and encoder

facebookresearch_meshtalk/training/train.run_Trainer_validation_step: run a validation step that evaluates models on a random batch from the validation dataset
facebookresearch_meshtalk/training/train.run_cycle_dataloader: run the cycle function to create an infinite iterator over a PyTorch DataLoader for continuous training
